# star-types

Patch rows on this catalog use `"catalog": "star-types"` and a `key` from the records below. The catalog is closed: a mod changes values with patch rows (see [Patch operations](patch-ops.md)) and cannot add records.

## Records

`blue`, `white`, `yellow`, `orange`, `red`, `brown`, `black_hole`

## Copy this row

A row that changes nothing: `value` and `expect` both hold the base value. Change `value` to the number you want.

```json
{
  "op": "set",
  "catalog": "star-types",
  "key": "blue",
  "path": "ageWeights.average",
  "value": 10,
  "expect": {"ageWeights.average":10}
}
```
